note: Captured once from a git archive export of the commit above (production build, Chromium, synthetic home) with BOARD_CAPTURE_CASE=header bun scripts/capture-board-geometry.ts. The home is seeded like production, all names invented: Claude accounts Main, Account B and Account C and Codex Main with usage readings, bound to the project through the Viewer's own modules; three AskUserQuestion transcripts held open by live processes (the island reads 3); five working agents across five tasks; two tasks off the board (Hidden 2); a quiet second project whose menu shows Archive and Delete. The export has no .git, so the commit is recorded here from the exported tree.
